source: Official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT aggregate trades and event-level BBO, 2024-01-15
feature: impact susceptibility equals absolute contemporaneous 10-second midpoint return divided by square root of absolute signed aggressive BTC normalized by trailing five-minute median gross volume
state: prior 10-second bin mean spread in bps divided by mean displayed BBO quantity
direct_gate: training-defined top-versus-bottom prior-state quintiles have a strictly positive 95% interval for block-level difference in mean susceptibility using 1000 deterministic resamples of eligible 10-minute test blocks
predictive_check: baseline versus baseline plus susceptibility, prior state and state-flow interaction for next-60-second jumps; gate is average-precision improvement greater than 0.02 and positive Brier improvement
interpretation: Direct replication supports state dependence of realized impact, not a deployable forecast.
